guitar.evidence: Dave Mustaine's Dean V signature (VMNT/Flying V) is iconic and well documented as his main instrument for most of Megadeth's career (after early Jackson King V years).
guitar.notes: Raised confidence to high since Mustaine's Dean V signature is genuinely iconic; simplified model list to focus on the most documented instrument.

tone.target: tight 80s thrash crunch with lead bite and dry attack
tone.profile: tight 80s thrash crunch with lead bite and dry attack
tone.summary: A classic Marshall-style setup using UK 45 or UK 50 with a Tube Screamer boost to achieve the necessary aggressive, mid-forward crunch required for 80s thrash metal.

rig.name: Megadeth - Tornado of Souls - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up high-gain noise and tighten the overall sound.
Simulate the Tube Screamer boost for tight upper-mid bite and attack enhancement.
blocks.gap: The dedicated TS model is absent, so 'Boost' is used to emulate its tightening effect.

blocks.purpose: Provide the core high-gain crunch and aggressive saturation needed for thrash.
Model the classic Marshall-style British high gain tone (UK 50) with strong mid-focus.
Provide the classic British cabinet sound and necessary punch for thrash.

alternatives.model: UK Basket 4x12 (if a slightly looser tone is desired)

blocks.purpose: Fine-tune the tone by boosting upper mids for bite and controlling low end tightness.

alternatives.model: Guitar EQ 1 (if less aggressive shaping is needed)

blocks.purpose: No wah needed for the core rhythm tone; kept inactive.
Add subtle rhythmic depth and sustain to lead lines without washing out the dry mix.
blocks.gap: The target is 'dry mix,' so delay settings are kept minimal/subtle.

alternatives.model: Tape (for a warmer, less defined echo)

blocks.purpose: Provide minimal spatial ambience for lead sustain without creating a 'reverb wash.'
blocks.gap: The target specifies avoiding 'reverb wash,' so the mix and decay are kept very low.

alternatives.model: Plate (for a more controlled, metallic ambience)

improvements.summary: Upgrade IR for increased punch and definition in fast rhythm playing.

proposals.reason: Enhance low-end tightness and upper-mid punch for fast thrash chugging.
